episodes.title: I Went Undercover Inside Latin America’s DEATH CULT… Santa Muerte
episodes.description:
I traveled to Piedras Negras, Mexico, with one mission: to expose the darkness behind Santa Muerte and proclaim the power of Jesus Christ.

Throughout this documentary, I encountered Santa Muerte worshippers, visited a botanica, sat down with former worshippers and ex-cartel members to hear their testimonies, and witnessed powerful moments of ministry, deliverance, and transformation.

My prayer is that this documentary opens eyes, exposes deception, and points people to the freedom found in Jesus Christ.
